subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: When the operator runs the status verb, the system shall render, per task/proposal await and configured-review obligation in the active scope: its state, what it waits on, wait age, a too-long flag, and the checker's last-check age; review rows shall additionally render the immutable revision, FR-15 `age_s`, provider review-attempt count, consumer recovery epoch/count/bound, last failure class, and an explicit exhausted/escalated state — read-only.
rationale: “quiet” must distinguish implementation wait, pending review, exhausted review, and a dead reader without the browser
fit_criterion: seeded waiting-on-review, CI-running, blocked, stale-wait, dead-checker, review-pending in each failure class, review-unknown, and review-exhausted fixtures render every required field and flag exactly the seeded stale/exhausted rows; the verb performs zero writes
